verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic SDKs: 13 client-side, 13 server-side and 4 edge (e.g., Cloudflare). Community users confirm a mobile client SDK, and clients download all project flags and then stream changes, so backend, web and mobile are covered by official SDKs evaluating the same centrally defined targeting rules. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-SDK evaluation consistency guarantees, per-platform SDK listing (web vs. mobile breakdown) in the pack, independent hands-on corroboration of consistent behavior across stacks (one community note also shows a language gap such as Elixir).

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: 30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.
LaunchDarkly has a mobile client SDK
LaunchDarkly SDKs can pass any context attributes you want to LaunchDarkly, where you can then use those attributes in flag targeting.
LD clients download all flags in the project on connection, then stream changes.
